sentence: This project studies how a social amoeba, bacteria inside it, and bacteriophages interact and change through evolution.
This project designs hairpin shaped RNA structures that stay stable when inserted into plant viruses that turn off genes of pathogens.
This project builds a machine learning tool that combines experimental and computer simulation results to predict how a material behaves at different length scales.
This project builds a framework that combines different kinds of secure computation so that large-scale data can be processed efficiently.
This project develops a mathematical framework that finds the internal state of a system from noisy or incomplete measurements by solving an optimization problem.
This project simulates how modified peptides and nucleosides react and break apart during collision-induced dissociation, and builds simulation software.
This project tries to find out which quinoa varieties grow well with less nitrogen fertilizer and which soil microorganisms help them.
This project develops tools to understand how error-correcting codes learned by neural networks work and why they perform well.
This project studies how pairs of excited electrons and empty states form, relax and move across the boundary between diamond and boron nitride.
This project builds an Earth system model that tracks stable water isotopes to study how water moves through the atmosphere, ocean and land.
This project studies how butterflies gain and lose red-green color vision and which genes and proteins are involved.
This project builds tools to forecast how grassland ecosystems change, combining field observations with computer models.
This project builds computer methods that use viral genomes to understand how viruses evolve and spread.
This project builds a virtual reality learning environment that teaches people in construction how to work safely with robots.
This project uses CRISPR gene editing to build a large collection of Daphnia mutants with genes knocked out, to learn what the genes do.
